subject: Motio 3.6 is here, update in one tap
text:
Hi {name},

A new Motio is out with redesigned profiles, smoother scrolling and in-app updates, so this is the last time you will need to install it by hand.

Download it on your Android phone:
https://github.com/kenan-karimli/motio/releases/latest/download/motio.apk

It installs over your current app and keeps all your trips and friends.

— Motio
